title: Pinned model artifacts for a CI model-change gate
description: A checked-in lockfile naming the exact remote model artifacts a model-gate action's run mode resolves and gates, keyed by role (typically 'baseline' and 'candidate', but any role name is allowed -- clozn does not fix the role set). SHA-256 is mandatory for every entry: this schema never accepts a remote model artifact whose checksum is unknown. `clozn.models.lockfile.load_lockfile()` is the reference reader and `clozn model-lock verify` remains offline. `clozn model-lock fetch` performs the separately authorized HTTPS download with bounded redirects, size checking, checksum verification, and atomic cache promotion.

pinned_model.description: One role's pinned artifact. quantization/chat_template_sha256 are optional -- omit rather than null-pad when not applicable to a given artifact.

url.description: Must be HTTPS. Redirects followed at download time must also stay HTTPS -- that is a downloader-time invariant, not one JSON Schema can express.

models.description: Role name -> pinned_model. At least one role is expected in practice; not enforced here since this validator has no non-empty-object keyword (roadmap rule: omit, never null-pad -- an empty models object is a legitimate, if useless, document rather than a schema violation).
